summary: Server banner disclosure through HTTP inspection.

remediation.config_change: Remove GET / from production builds or require an administrator session; never serialize configuration values into responses; move secrets to an injected secret store so they cannot appear in any dump.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule REQUEST_URI "@rx ^/" "id:9100011,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay info-disclosure virtual patch f-1fcca4728961d56d',tag:'assay/info-disclosure'"
{"class":"info-disclosure","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-1fcca4728961d56d","id":9100011,"rule":"SecRule REQUEST_URI \"@rx ^/\" \"id:9100011,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay info-disclosure virtual patch f-1fcca4728961d56d',tag:'assay/info-disclosure'\""}

summary: Weak JWT configuration detected, exposing user claims without proper protection.

validation.note: bearer token is not a JWT

remediation.config_change: Verify JWT signatures with an asymmetric algorithm pinned server-side (reject alg=none and algorithm switching); rotate the signing key; set short expiry and validate iss and aud on GET /api/users.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS:Authorization "@rx (?i)^bearer\s+eyJhbGciOiJub25l" "id:9100015,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay jwt-weak virtual patch f-253c80d2cb933f6e',tag:'assay/jwt-weak'"
{"class":"jwt-weak","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-253c80d2cb933f6e","id":9100015,"rule":"SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS:Authorization \"@rx (?i)^bearer\\s+eyJhbGciOiJub25l\" \"id:9100015,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay jwt-weak virtual patch f-253c80d2cb933f6e',tag:'assay/jwt-weak'\""}

summary: Missing security headers (X-Frame-Options, Content-Security-Policy, X-XSS-Protection) and Content-Type header disclosure.

remediation.code_diff:
--- a/handlers/router.go
+++ b/handlers/router.go
@@ -58,10 +58,13 @@
 	return s.middleware(mux)
 }
 
-// middleware adds permissive CORS and recovers panics with a verbose page.
-// VULN: security-headers no Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options or Referrer-Policy are ever set
+// middleware sets baseline security headers, adds CORS and recovers panics.
 func (s *Server) middleware(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
 	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		w.Header().Set("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'")
+		w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
+		w.Header().Set("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")
+		w.Header().Set("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer")
 		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*") // VULN: cors-misconfig wildcard origin combined with credentials
 		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials", "true")
 		w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Authorization, Content-Type")
remediation.config_change: Set Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY (or frame-ancestors), Referrer-Policy: no-referrer and, over TLS, Strict-Transport-Security on every response in shared middleware or at the reverse proxy.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule &RESPONSE_HEADERS:Content-Security-Policy "@eq 0" "id:9100012,phase:3,pass,log,t:none,msg:'assay security-headers virtual patch f-be983aea8cbfd46f',tag:'assay/security-headers'"
{"class":"security-headers","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-be983aea8cbfd46f","id":9100012,"rule":"SecRule \u0026RESPONSE_HEADERS:Content-Security-Policy \"@eq 0\" \"id:9100012,phase:3,pass,log,t:none,msg:'assay security-headers virtual patch f-be983aea8cbfd46f',tag:'assay/security-headers'\""}

summary: Potential open redirect vulnerability found in /healthcheck endpoint.

remediation.config_change: On GET /healthcheck, accept only relative paths or destinations from an explicit allowlist for redirect; resolve the target and compare host and scheme before redirecting; otherwise redirect to the site root.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule ARGS:redirect "@rx ^(?i)(https?:)?//" "id:9100008,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:lowercase,msg:'assay open-redirect virtual patch f-4ddc0c9eda5009f7',tag:'assay/open-redirect'"
{"class":"open-redirect","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-4ddc0c9eda5009f7","id":9100008,"rule":"SecRule ARGS:redirect \"@rx ^(?i)(https?:)?//\" \"id:9100008,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:lowercase,msg:'assay open-redirect virtual patch f-4ddc0c9eda5009f7',tag:'assay/open-redirect'\""}

summary: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) misconfiguration detected for the / endpoint, allowing unauthorized access.

remediation.config_change: Replace Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with an explicit allowlist of origins compared exactly; never combine a wildcard or reflected origin with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true; omit CORS headers for same-origin APIs.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule RESPONSE_HEADERS:Access-Control-Allow-Origin "@streq *" "id:9100013,phase:3,pass,log,t:none,msg:'assay cors-misconfig virtual patch f-6016341fd5b70be1',tag:'assay/cors-misconfig'"
{"class":"cors-misconfig","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-6016341fd5b70be1","id":9100013,"rule":"SecRule RESPONSE_HEADERS:Access-Control-Allow-Origin \"@streq *\" \"id:9100013,phase:3,pass,log,t:none,msg:'assay cors-misconfig virtual patch f-6016341fd5b70be1',tag:'assay/cors-misconfig'\""}

summary: A reflected XSS vulnerability is present in the login page due to the lack of validation or sanitization on the 'username' and 'password' fields.

remediation.config_change: HTML-escape <parameter> before writing it into the page for GET /login (html/template or the framework's auto-escaping renderer); send Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8 and a Content-Security-Policy without 'unsafe-inline'.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule ARGS:* "@detectXSS" "id:9100002,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,msg:'assay xss-reflected virtual patch f-fd046096c6ea825b',tag:'assay/xss-reflected'"
